subject: USC
body: What is the supreme law of the land?
explanation: The Constitution sets up the government and protects basic rights.

subject: USC
body: What are the first ten amendments to the Constitution called?
explanation: They were ratified in 1791.

subject: USC
body: The idea of self-government is in the first three words of the Constitution. What are these words?
explanation: The government gets its power from the people.

subject: USC
body: What is an amendment?
options: A change or addition to the Constitution
A law passed by a state
explanation: There are 27 amendments.

subject: USC
body: How many amendments does the Constitution have?
explanation: The first ten are the Bill of Rights.

subject: USC
body: What did the Declaration of Independence do?
explanation: It was adopted on July 4, 1776.

subject: USC
body: What is freedom of religion?
options: You can practice any religion, or not practice a religion
explanation: Protected by the First Amendment.

subject: USC
body: What is the economic system in the United States?
explanation: Also called a market economy.

subject: USC
body: What is the 'rule of law'?
options: Everyone must follow the law, including leaders and government
explanation: No one is above the law.

subject: USC
body: What are the three branches of government?
explanation: Separation of powers.

subject: USC
body: What stops one branch of government from becoming too powerful?
explanation: Each branch can limit the others.

subject: USC
body: Who is in charge of the executive branch?
explanation: The President heads the executive branch.

subject: USC
body: Who makes federal laws?
explanation: Congress is the legislative branch.

subject: USC
body: How many U.S. Senators are there?
explanation: Two from each of the 50 states.

subject: USC
body: We elect a U.S. Senator for how many years?
explanation: Senate terms are six years.

subject: USC
body: How many voting members are in the House of Representatives?
explanation: Seats are divided by state population.

subject: USC
body: We elect a U.S. Representative for how many years?
explanation: House elections are every two years.

subject: USC
body: We elect a President for how many years?
explanation: A President can serve at most two elected terms.

subject: USC
body: In what month do we vote for President?
explanation: Election Day is in November.

subject: USC
body: If the President can no longer serve, who becomes President?
explanation: Next in line after the VP is the Speaker of the House.

subject: USC
body: Who is the Commander in Chief of the military?
options: The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs
explanation: Civilian control of the military.

subject: USC
body: Who signs bills to become laws?
explanation: The President can also veto bills.

subject: USC
body: Who vetoes bills?
explanation: Congress can override a veto with a two-thirds vote in both houses.

subject: USC
body: What is the highest court in the United States?
explanation: It is the head of the judicial branch.

subject: USC
body: How many justices are on the Supreme Court?
explanation: Set by law, not by the Constitution.

subject: USC
body: Under the Constitution, some powers belong to the states. Which is one?
explanation: Also police, driver's licenses and zoning.

subject: USC
body: Under the Constitution, some powers belong to the federal government. Which is one?
explanation: Also declaring war and making treaties.

subject: USC
body: What are the two major political parties in the United States?
explanation: These have been the main parties since the 1850s.

subject: USC
body: Name one right only for United States citizens.
explanation: Running for federal office is another.

subject: USC
body: How old do citizens have to be to vote for President?
explanation: Set by the 26th Amendment.

subject: USC
body: When is the last day you can send in federal income tax forms?
explanation: Usually April 15.

subject: USC
body: Which is one responsibility only for United States citizens?
explanation: Voting in federal elections is another.

subject: USC
body: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?
options: The United States and the flag
explanation: The Pledge is to the flag and the republic.

subject: USC
body: At what age must all men register for the Selective Service?
explanation: Registration is required by law.

subject: USC
body: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
explanation: Adopted July 4, 1776.

subject: USC
body: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?
explanation: Independence Day.

subject: USC
body: There were 13 original states. Which is one of them?
explanation: Others include New York, Pennsylvania and Massachusetts.

subject: USC
body: When was the Constitution written?
explanation: At the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia.

subject: USC
body: Who is the 'Father of Our Country'?
explanation: He was also the first President.

subject: USC
body: Who was the first President?
explanation: He served from 1789 to 1797.

subject: USC
body: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
explanation: Also Alexander Hamilton and John Jay.

subject: USC
body: What is Benjamin Franklin famous for?
options: U.S. diplomat and oldest member of the Constitutional Convention
Writing the Bill of Rights alone
explanation: Also first Postmaster General and author of Poor Richard's Almanac.

subject: USC
body: What territory did the United States buy from France in 1803?
explanation: The Louisiana Purchase.

subject: USC
body: Name the U.S. war between the North and the South.

subject: USC
body: What did the Emancipation Proclamation do?
options: Freed the slaves in most Southern states
explanation: Issued by Lincoln in 1863.

subject: USC
body: What was one important thing Abraham Lincoln did?
options: Preserved the Union during the Civil War
explanation: He also freed the slaves (Emancipation Proclamation).

subject: USC
body: What did Susan B. Anthony do?
explanation: She also fought for civil rights.

subject: USC
body: Who was President during World War I?
explanation: The U.S. entered the war in 1917.

subject: USC
body: Who was President during the Great Depression and World War II?
explanation: He was elected four times.

subject: USC
body: Before he was President, Eisenhower was a general. What war was he in?
explanation: He was Supreme Allied Commander in Europe.

subject: USC
body: What did Martin Luther King, Jr. do?
explanation: He worked for equality for all Americans.

subject: USC
body: What major event happened on September 11, 2001, in the United States?
explanation: Nearly 3,000 people were killed.

subject: USC
body: What is the capital of the United States?
explanation: It is not part of any state.

subject: USC
body: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
explanation: A gift from France.

subject: USC
body: Why does the flag have 13 stripes?
explanation: The 50 stars represent the 50 states.

subject: USC
body: What is the name of the national anthem?
explanation: Written by Francis Scott Key.

subject: USC
body: Name one of the two longest rivers in the United States.
explanation: The Missouri River is the other.

subject: USC
body: Which ocean is on the West Coast of the United States?
explanation: The Atlantic is on the East Coast.

subject: USC
body: When do we celebrate Independence Day?
explanation: Marks the Declaration of Independence.
